epic: Customer master data realistic data route
purpose: Convert the existing placeholder customer U-CUST-100 into the realistic fictional first customer Saarland Maschinenbau AG using a narrow identity/contact write gate.
businessPurpose: Make the first customer master record useful for training, handbook and later O2C preparation without duplicating customer numbers or touching accounting setup.

smartDecision.whyNow: The placeholder U-CUST-100 has read-first zero-dependency signals and blocks the intended first realistic customer number. A narrow identity conversion is more realistic than creating a duplicate.
sourceBasis: Read-first evidence observed U-CUST-100 with customer card, statistics/FactBoxes and Customer Ledger Entries context.
Local route decision selected controlled conversion over alternate number.
smartDecision.risk: Customer identity becomes more realistic, but accounting setup remains incomplete. The result must not be used as O2C or posting readiness.
smartDecision.fallback: If the card is not the expected placeholder or field editing is unsafe, stop and write a blocked result; do not create a second customer.

screenshotQaRequired: Before screenshot showing U-CUST-100 / Universaarl Kunde 100 in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE
Edit/write screenshot or text checkpoint showing only identity/contact fields targeted
After-save screenshot showing Saarland Maschinenbau AG
Reopen proof screenshot showing persisted Saarland Maschinenbau AG
acceptanceCriteria: U-CUST-100 is changed from Universaarl Kunde 100 to Saarland Maschinenbau AG only if the expected placeholder state is visible before write.
Only allowed identity/contact fields are changed.
No posting group, VAT group, payment term, dimension, template, document, Preview Posting, Posting, payment or API shortcut is touched.
Reopen proof confirms the changed identity persisted.
Result JSON clearly states masterDataChanged true and setupChanged false.
Next case remains setup/payment/posting readiness, not O2C execution.
stopIf: Customer U-CUST-100 no longer has the expected placeholder name before write.
Unexpected balance, open document or dependency signal appears.
The route would need posting, VAT, payment, dimensions, template or document changes.
A dialog asks to post, preview, create a document, change setup or confirm a broader operation.
Screenshot QA cannot prove before/after/reopen state.
completedScope: U-CUST-100 / Saarland Maschinenbau AG is visible after save/autosave and after reopen proof.
Address, post code, city, e-mail and contact are visible on the Customer Card.
No setup, document, Preview Posting, Posting, payment or API shortcut was executed in the successful proof run.
remainingScope: Country/Region Code DE is not proven on the visible card.
Search Name/Suchbegriff is not proven on the current card layout.
Customer Posting Group, Gen. Bus. Posting Group, VAT Bus. Posting Group, Payment Terms, Payment Method and Dimensions remain separate read-first/setup dependencies.
